map.钢材采购与运输按重量计费。选择型材类型，输入尺寸与长度，按理论重量公式（密度 7: Steel purchasing and transport are charged by weight. Choose a section type, enter dimensions and length, and the theoretical weight formula (density 7.85 g/cm³) converts the weight automatically.

map.采购备料：按型材理论米重 × 长度估算单根/整批重量，快速核对外购吨位与运费，避: Purchasing and material preparation: estimate the weight of a single piece or a whole batch from the theoretical metre weight × length, to check purchased tonnage and freight quickly and avoid blind quoting by piece count.
map.运输与吊装：理论重量用于货车载重、吊具额定与堆场承载力校核，尤其在多规格混装时统: Transport and lifting: theoretical weight is used for truck payload, lifting gear rating and yard bearing checks, especially when aggregating by weight with mixed sections.

map.按碳钢密度 7.85 g/cm³ 推导的经验系数（圆钢 0.00617、方钢/扁: Empirical coefficients derived from the carbon steel density 7.85 g/cm³ (round bar 0.00617, square bar / flat bar / angle 0.00785): round bar a²×0.00617 = 20²×0.00617 = 2.468 kg/m, total 2.468×6 ≈ 14.81 kg; square bar a²×0.00785 = 3.14 kg/m, total 18.84 kg; flat bar a×b×0.00785 = 20×10×0.00785 = 1.57 kg/m, total 9.42 kg; equal angle (2a−t)×t×0.00785 = (40−3)×3×0.00785 = 0.871 kg/m, total 5.23 kg; channel (a+b−2t)×t×0.00785×1.05 = (20+10−6)×3×0.00785×1.05 = 0.593 kg/m, total 3.56 kg (the ×1.05 includes a correction for thicker leg ends).
map.经验系数 0.00617 / 0.00785 是怎么来的？: Where do the coefficients 0.00617 and 0.00785 come from?
map.由密度 7.85 g/cm³ 推导：把尺寸单位 mm 换成 cm、长度 m 换成: Derived from the density 7.85 g/cm³: converting dimensions from mm to cm and length from m to cm, the unit volume mass 7.85 g/cm³ becomes about 0.00785 in kg/m·mm²; for round bar, multiplying 0.00785 by the area ratio π/4 ≈ 0.785 between π(d/2)² and (d/2)² gives 0.00617. The coefficients are approximations including rolling fillets and negative tolerance; settlement follows the weighbridge.
map.理论重量和过磅重量差很多正常吗？: Is a large difference between theoretical and weighed weight normal?
map.正常。理论重量按公称尺寸计算，实际允许 ±5% 左右公差，且表面锈蚀、涂层、负偏: Yes. Theoretical weight uses nominal dimensions, actual tolerance is around ±5%, and surface rust, coating and negative tolerance make actual weight lower than theoretical. For bulk purchasing, use the weighbridge or the theoretical weight plus tolerance for settlement and capacity checks; this tool's results are estimates.
map.理论重量按密度 7.85 g/cm³ 计算，为近似值: Theoretical weight is calculated at a density of 7.85 g/cm³ and is an approximation
map.圆钢 0.00617、方钢 0.00785、扁钢 0.00785 为常用经验系数: Round bar 0.00617, square bar 0.00785 and flat bar 0.00785 are common empirical coefficients
map.型材实际重量允许 ±5% 左右公差: Actual section weight allows around ±5% tolerance
map.结果仅供参考，结算以过磅重量为准: Results are for reference only; settlement follows the weighed weight
map.型钢理论重量（碳钢密度 7.85 g/cm³ 口径）：米重按型材下拉——圆钢 =: Theoretical weight of steel profiles (carbon steel density 7.85 g/cm³): mass per metre by type — round bar = a²×0.00617; round tube (outer diameter a, wall thickness t) = π·t·(a−t)×0.00785; square bar = a²×0.00785; flat bar = a×b×0.00785; equal angle = (2a−t)×t×0.00785; channel = (a+2b−2t)×t×0.00785 (kg/m, two flanges plus web approximation); total weight = mass per metre × length L(m). Validation: a ≤0 or L ≤0 shows “please enter valid main dimensions and length”; round tube requires 0<t<a/2; angle/channel require t>0, and channel also requires b>t. A reference table of common profile weights is included for comparison.
map.壁厚/边厚 t（mm，圆管/角钢/槽钢用）: Wall/leg thickness t (mm, for round tube/angle/channel)
map.按碳钢密度 7.85 g/cm³ 推导的经验系数（圆钢 0.00617、方钢/扁: Empirical coefficients derived from 7.85 g/cm³ carbon steel (round bar 0.00617; square/flat/angle 0.00785): round bar a²×0.00617 = 20²×0.00617 = 2.468 kg/m, total 2.468×6 ≈ 14.81 kg; round tube π·t·(a−t)×0.00785 = 3.1416×3×17×0.00785 = 1.258 kg/m, total 7.55 kg; square bar a²×0.00785 = 3.14 kg/m, total 18.84 kg; flat bar a×b×0.00785 = 20×10×0.00785 = 1.57 kg/m, total 9.42 kg; equal angle (2a−t)×t×0.00785 = (40−3)×3×0.00785 = 0.871 kg/m, total 5.23 kg; channel (a+2b−2t)×t×0.00785 = (20+20−6)×3×0.00785 = 0.801 kg/m, total 4.80 kg (two flanges plus web approximation).
map.按碳钢密度 7.85 g/cm³ 理论计算。圆钢：a²×0.00617；圆管：π: Calculated theoretically at 7.85 g/cm³ carbon steel density. Round bar: a²×0.00617; round tube: π·t·(a−t)×0.00785 (outer diameter a, wall thickness t); square bar: a²×0.00785; flat bar: a×b×0.00785; equal angle: (2a−t)×t×0.00785; channel: (a+2b−2t)×t×0.00785 (two flanges plus web approximation). Actual weight varies with tolerances and surface condition.
map.圆管壁厚需满足 0 < t < a/2。: Round tube wall thickness must satisfy 0 < t < a/2.
map.扁钢需填写大于 0 的次尺寸 b。: Flat bar requires a secondary dimension b greater than 0.
map.角钢边厚需满足 0 < t < a。: Angle leg thickness must satisfy 0 < t < a.
map.槽钢需满足 0 < t < b，且次尺寸 b 大于 0。: Channel requires 0 < t < b, and the secondary dimension b must be greater than 0.
